::: {.status}
**Version 0.1, October 2, 2026. Next review by January 2027.** AI tools change fast: participants at ACLCA 2026 noted that hallucination behavior changed noticeably within six months. We review this guidance quarterly, and each page shows its own date.
:::

These pages are the working outputs of the [AI for LCA of emerging technologies](../projects/ai-for-lca.qmd) project. They are drafts for discussion, built from community input at ACLCA 2026 and from the published literature.

## Two principles behind everything here

**Assist, do not invent.** AI that retrieves, summarizes, maps, or checks information is assistance. AI that produces inventory values with no underlying source is generation, which practitioners at ACLCA 2026 described as bordering on malpractice.

**Trust but verify, and verify more at low TRL.** Model predictions are reliable only near their training data. An emerging technology is, by definition, far from most of it.

## The pages

- [Decision tool by TRL](decision-tool.qmd): which AI tasks are reliable at which stage of technology development
- [Disclosure template](disclosure.qmd): what to declare when AI contributed to a study
- [Red flags](red-flags.qmd): failures practitioners have actually seen, and what to do instead
- [Literature inventory](literature.qmd): the papers we are reviewing and what each contributes
